python -c "
import parse
# Test with named field
r = parse.parse('name: {name:w}', 'name: abc')
print(r)
print('Fixed:', r.fixed if r else 'None')
print('Named:', r.named if r else 'None')
if r:
    print(\"r['name']:\", r['name'])
" 2>&1 | tail -5
